What Henry Ford's lawsuit teaches about adversity.

Kevin Trudeau points to Henry Ford, who was sued over his right to keep making cars. If he lost, his business was finished.

Kevin asks how anyone faces that, and what mindset it takes to stay steady so close to disaster. He also looks at soldiers in battle.

His point: the adversity most of us face is small next to what the ultra successful have been through.

What would change if you saw your biggest problem as small?

#ad #success #mindset #kevintrudeau

Why the same setback breaks one person and not another.

Kevin Trudeau shares a quote he likes: adversity causes some men to break, but others to break records.

The point is simple. It comes down to whether you let adversity break you or you use it to your advantage.

Which one will you choose the next time something goes wrong?
